hypothesis: A fixed named group in the existing footer gap can preserve commissioned cat HP/rage/status identity without world-label/body occlusion. Requires visual association and complete paint validation; nominal capacity alone is insufficient.
scope: Only successfully prepared Mochi/Clover media actors. Native actors/media fallback keep existing world presentation. No Soot changes.
phase1: Unchanged live computed footer/speed/party/action boxes and full-state/raw-canvas pilot first. No prototype before capacity results.

candidate.focus: Contained inset outline; no shrink or clipping of text/icons to force fit
candidate.identity: Always-visible name and programmatic named group; original portrait ultimate buttons untouched

unchanged: canvas, body pixels and rule outcomes
status titles/accessibility names, stack counts, shield and overflow information
sourcePolicy: World labels remain measured geometry reservations while their transferred presentation is hidden; fallback restores them. No adopted patch until native baseline/candidate fulltrajectory and paint gates plus once-only visual review pass.
rejectionPolicy: Any dimension/paint/status/focus/association failure is retained and stops adoption; do not refit offsets, shrink icons, drop statuses or move controls after evaluation.
